title: Demo: our practice dataset says pizza arrives 10 minutes faster at night. Will the re-run agree?
statement: Made-up practice data, not real research. A short script compares the delivery times of a pretend pizza shop by day and by night.

mock_llm.repair: {"give_up": true, "reason": "pizza_sums is a package that was never published, and it holds the calculation itself. Replacing it would change the result being tested.", "edits": []}
